title: stelis tenebrosa
intro: Stelis tenebrosa, commonly known as the "Dark-stemmed Stelis," is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate conditions such as fever, colds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Stelis tenebrosa include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit analgesic and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of Stelis tenebrosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
